```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("R/gallery.R")
```

```{r}
#| label: about-hero
tags$div(
  class = "about-container",

  # ── Banner image ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tags$img(
    src   = picsum_url("auggie-about", 1720L, 968L),
    class = "about-hero-img",
    alt   = "Auggie Smith photographing in the field"
  ),

  # ── Bio ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tags$h2("About"),
  tags$p(
    "I am a photographer based in the Pacific Northwest, drawn to the quiet",
    "beauty of landscapes, the authenticity of documentary portraiture, and",
    "the unexpected poetry found in city streets."
  ),
  tags$p(
    "Photography, for me, is an act of paying attention \u2014 of being present",
    "enough to notice what most people walk past. Whether I am waiting for",
    "light to fall just right on a mountain ridge, or chasing a fleeting",
    "expression in a crowded market, I am always searching for that singular",
    "moment where everything comes together."
  ),
  tags$p(
    "My work has been exhibited across the region and published in editorial",
    "and commercial contexts. I am available for landscape, portrait, and",
    "editorial assignments, as well as fine-art print commissions."
  ),

  # ── Recognition ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tags$h2("Recognition & Publications"),
  {
    recognition <- list(
      list(year = 2024, item = "Pacific Northwest Photography Award \u2014 Landscape finalist"),
      list(year = 2022, item = "Travel + Leisure Magazine \u2014 Contributing photographer (2022\u20132024)"),
      list(year = 2023, item = "Northwest Galleries, Portland \u2014 Solo exhibition, \u201cLight & Distance\u201d"),
      list(year = 2021, item = "Documentary Photography Fellowship \u2014 State Arts Commission"),
      list(year = 2020, item = "Outdoor Photographer \u2014 Featured portfolio")
    )
    # Sort descending by year
    recognition <- recognition[order(sapply(recognition, `[[`, "year"), decreasing = TRUE)]
    items <- lapply(recognition, function(r) {
      tags$li(
        tags$strong(r$year),
        HTML(paste0(" &nbsp;\u2014&nbsp; ", r$item))
      )
    })
    do.call(tags$ul, items)
  },

  # ── Approach ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tags$h2("Approach"),
  tags$p(
    "I believe a photograph earns its place not by being technically",
    "perfect, but by making you feel something. I shoot available light",
    "whenever possible, preferring the honesty of natural conditions over",
    "the control of a studio. My post-processing philosophy is restrained:",
    "enhance what is already there, remove nothing that belongs."
  ),

  # ── Equipment ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tags$h2("Equipment"),
  {
    gear <- c(
      "Nikon Z7 II (primary body)",
      "NIKKOR Z 24mm f/1.8 S",
      "NIKKOR Z 50mm f/1.2 S",
      "NIKKOR Z 85mm f/1.8 S",
      "Carbon-fibre tripod with ball head",
      "Neutral-density filter set (3\u201310 stop)"
    )
    items <- lapply(gear, tags$li)
    do.call(tags$ul, items)
  },

  tags$hr(),

  # ── CTA ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tags$div(
    style = "text-align:center; margin-top:2rem;",
    tags$a(href = "contact.html", class = "btn-photo btn-photo-muted", "Get in Touch")
  )
)
```
